pages.title: Peano Arithmetic Engine
pages.text: Builds number systems the way mathematicians did: zero, then "the next one", then negatives, fractions, reals and beyond.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Peano needed only zero and 'successor' to define all of arithmetic. So I begin with $(item)Natural Number Lattices$(). Antimatter gives you negatives ($(item)Integer Ring$()), Casimir plates divide ($(item)Rational Field$()). For the reals you need $(item)Transcendental Crystals$() from the Platonic Realm.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Axiom Schema, Axiom Stone, Imaginary Unit, Integer Ring, Microstate Tally, Natural Number Lattice, Octonion Crystal, Prime Shard, Quaternion Crystal, Rational Field, Spinor Lattice.
One, two, three... Peano built all of arithmetic from zero and "the next one".$(br2)Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().
The naturals, plus their antimatter reflections: every number now has a negative.$(br2)Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().
Every ratio of integers. Dense everywhere - and still full of holes.$(br2)Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().
π and e, which no polynomial can reach. Only found in the Platonic Realm.$(br2)Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Natural Number Lattice$(): Aleph-Null Shard, Axiom Schema, Axiom Stone, Cantor Key, Empty Set and more$(li)$(item)Integer Ring$(): Empirical Notes III, Network Map, Platonic Compass, Rational Field, Symmetry Crystal and more$(li)$(item)Rational Field$(): Analytic Continuator, Clonal Selector, Confidence Seal, Dosing Pump, Enzyme Assay Bench and more$(li)$(item)Transcendental Crys...
